notes.title: Quality of Life patch
notes.notes:
[h3]Increased the player's chest capacity[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/2bd8eda3b37c95e8daf3c85b4e5980b5f095fcd1.png[/img]
(I also plan to release an add-on that will make the chest infinite)

[h3]Souls-like gamepad control redesign [/h3]
Now the right bumper is an attack, the left is a block. And running can be turned on with the left stick or X
Added hotkeys for fast movement and quick equipping of an item
Improved gamepad control in the inventory
Now you can switch between mouse and gamepad during the game (solo mode)
To switch from gamepad to mouse, left-click or Enter
To switch to gamepad, press A or Start
Improved Dead Zone for gamepads
Changed Dodge Roll buttons on keyboard. Now it is C Q Left-Ctrl Left-Alt

[h3]New Craft[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/5cc7c1d67079b9190294b3b99c53154f605bf0fc.png[/img]
Level up any item! Combine 4 of the same items, and then the first one will get +1
Now it makes sense to collect identical items. You can also buy items and combine them.
A new recipe book is now sold in the dark library
Now you can craft Royal Endrian Stones (the highest rank stone)
Now you can craft Uber Scrolls (rank 4 scroll).
When you mix:
3 red scrolls + gold ring = Uber Scroll Fragment
3 Uberscroll Fragments + Endrian Stone of the Royal level = Uberscroll
Uberscroll have VERY powerful effects
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/41c38a78e3ca04c7d29a8ded0ca646e5a2620e4e.png[/img]
(Also, the Uberscroll fragment can drop from the Mysterious Chest that Fakhim sells, or as an artifact anywhere, but the chance is small)

[h3]Extra[/h3]
Fakhim now sells the Mysterious Chest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/fcc0674d5f42132c0cb95745ba092b9f12485a21.png[/img]
Now the Svitlanka potion shows detailed enemy stats
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/701d60e766505d94d2a20b8093f8b4b8aee473c1.png[/img]
The time of the potion effect is now displayed
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/4313308acd3c9a584a6cc34b8f2226d2f65df488.png[/img]
Now a hint appears when there are free stat points
Added several dialogues
Added two new variants of poisonous traps.
Added the display of the key on the map of the location with mushrooms.
Improved loot in the location where Fakhim teaches you how to use stones.
Improved loot in the location where you are taught how to use scrolls.
Added a new enemy—Thunder Spider, who bites with lightning damage and teleports.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
Books close on escape
Music doesn't stop now
Fixed a bug with 3D sound
Fixed a bug with the volume of the sound when starting the game.
Fixed a bug with the White Lord

notes.title: 9-3 Controll changes and polishing
notes.notes:
[h3]Changed controls
[/h3]
Now jump and roll use different buttons.
On the keyboard, Dodge Roll is C or V or Left-Alt.
On the gamepad, Jump is Y and Dodge Roll is B.
Improved navigation in the inventory grid in the gamepad.
Added sound when moving the cursor with the gamepad.

[h3]Extra Changes:[/h3]
Added Leonardo to the dungeon with mushrooms, where he will give a hint on how to brew a powerful potion.
Added a mini dungeon in which Fakhim teaches you how to use Endrian Stones.
Added a mini dungeon in which you are taught how to use scrolls.
Added a book with instructions on scrolls to the library.
Changed the artefact in the event chest.

notes.title: Map update
notes.notes:
[i]I was able to take a big step forward in the direction of what I wanted Trapped Souls to be. The campaign map is now large and has a new content to explore. 
[/i]

[h3]Update v5[/h3]
The campaign map has been completely redesigned. Now explore the dungeons and complete various challenges to find keys and open doors. The map controller now follows the player, also added step sounds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/974b04a76b033b31af0b2a05198a49a574ee5686.gif[/img]
Mini dungeons and single rooms
Mini-dungeons are small dungeons in which you will have to roll a die to move, just like in the dungeons of the main bosses. At the end, you will mostly receive a reward or a special location such as Mushroom cave (best place to collect mushrooms)
Single rooms
Single rooms are locations from roguelike dungeons, although there are also unique ones such as Treasure room with 5 chest or battles with extra bosses. Most of these locations are one-time (in the future, it will be possible to play in New game+ and then it will be possible to go through them again)
 
New Bosses: 
-Red &Blue Lords
-Green Lord
-Purple Lord
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/2f53662c7326759ff9bcfc1fae95c646d10af9bc.png[/img]
New Bosses are very strong, maybe even stronger than campaign bosses, I advise you to prepare a good elemental defense to defeat them. As a reward for defeating them, you will receive Endrian Stones of the highest level

New Roguelike dungeon effect "Feathers" moving you 10 steps forward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/778fab72d1f7ba7c42ac30e76e70ae1974662617.png[/img]
Treasure hunt minigame
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/1b60bd70165e62872f4d40816eb1e8bb7d0a2fbc.png[/img]
100 gold is spawned at each entrance to the cemetery. With each finding, the number of coins increases by +5
The number of coins that Josephine has is now 300, but every time you find her, this number increases by +5
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/8f0b12ce1be6021e3d2b0502b2214cd19d848d38.gif[/img]

Improvements:
Most Items got + 1 socket 
Items drop with higher level now. And the variety of levels is improved
Silver rings got X2 stronger!
Potion of light - power of light increased
Dark library loot improved
1 Boss dungeon length changed to 50 steps
2 Boss dungeon length changed to 62 steps
Green potion duration increased to 90 seconds
Fixed bug: green potion buff disappears after using another potion
fixed silver chest item bug

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
[h2][i]
Over the past 3 months, I've reworked and polished most of the game, fixed critical bugs, replaced some textures, improved gameplay, improved sounds, and added a lot of new content.[/i][/h2]
[h2]Version 3 alpha:[/h2]

[h3]Dodge Roll[/h3]
The small jump has been replaced by a dodge roll.
The first couple of dodge-roll frames grant you invulnerability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/4f74d50cc3bbbc9c59c6de20abe7dd5bff7d1cbe.gif[/img]

[h3]Roguelike Relics[/h3]
During your dungeon runs, you will come across the Altar of Hope, which will give you a choice of one of three relics. Collected relics reset with each new run.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/c6993a8c21be45c221a165035c26d0c1a21bc248.png[/img]
[h3]Improved dungeon mode[/h3]
Added new challenges:
[list]
[*] Elite- Fight with powerful enemies
[*] Curse- With each curse, enemies become stronger and traps become more dangerous
[*] Altar of Hope- A safe place where you will be rewarded with a relic
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/a2dbda04bd9dcedd0420d9846c8e9c8328bf4db1.jpg[/img]

[h3]Second dice for dungeon mode[/h3]
Although I wanted to create a feeling of an unknown challenge, I also did not want everything to be pure randomness. That's why I added the second dice. Now you can choose between challenges. Sometimes it is beneficial to choose a smaller number so as not to miss something valuable or get into trouble.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/7dbcce57f723f6e99d8a1dec76a34e71de28f936.gif[/img]

[h3]UI[/h3]
UI usability was improved, inventory is now the first menu. The gamepad navigation has been significantly improved. When hovering over an item, its characteristics are displayed in popup. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/70f34d0288b46c518c0f18a450de9c57588d139e.png[/img]

[h3]Socketing now works through item combination[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/57f1f30b12230092d58df3eee079142f4f624b92.gif[/img]


[h3]Josephine in Dungeon[/h3]
Rarely during dungeon runs you can meet Josephine with a bunch of gold coins
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/8f0b12ce1be6021e3d2b0502b2214cd19d848d38.gif[/img]

[h3]Important changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bag items dont drop after death anymore!
[*] Strength, Dexterity and Willpower parameters have been removed, so you can equip any weapon and equipment
[*] New parameter-  "Load" has been added. The load increases the stamina cost of dodge roll
[*] Improved gamepad inventory management
[*] Socketing now works through combining
[*] Gozzo now also sells shields and magic staffs. Also, new expensive things such as broadsword and chain armor appeared for sale
[*] Potions have become more powerful
[*] The crafting slot can be used as an inventory slot
[*] 100% chance gold drop from mobs
[*] Gold gain rebalance
[*] Auto pick-up gold from mobs
[*] Blocking with a shield now turns on immediately after pressing the button
[*] When shield block is hit, less energy is lost
[*] Improved Tutorial
[*] Added unique rewards for defeating d boss bosses
[*] The amount of gold the player picked up is now displayed
[*] The item that the player picked up is now displayed
[*] Added volume settings to the main menu
[*] Added Jump buffer
[*] Add Damage dealt to enemy popup
[*] Improved sound design
[*] When pressing the left mouse button, you can now throw out the selected item
[*] Reworked loot drop table. Scrolls and armor drop from copper chests, weapons from elite opponents
[/list]
